description: TEMPLATE (filled in with the real values for test 1). Generate test 1: Section A (General English), Topic: Articles (a / an / the, zero article), 30 questions, difficulty_profile: foundation. Save to mock-tests/tests/1_test_A_articles.json. Then run python3 mock-tests/_record_test.py 1.
steps: Read mock-tests/config.json to confirm next_test, then read the matching entry in mock-tests/manifest.json for the full spec (section, topic, total_questions, difficulty_profile, filename).
Read ONLY mock-tests/history/A.json to list every existing question stem for this section and avoid exact or reworded duplicates. Do not bulk-read mock-tests/tests/.

Generate 30 questions on the given topic following the steering prompt. Type distribution for 30Q: Single Correct MCQ 12, Statement-based 5, Assertion-Reason 3, Matching 3, Multiple Correct Combination 3, Fill in the Blank 1, Numerical Value 1, Data Interpretation 2. SUBJECT-FIT SUBSTITUTION: Section A (General English) does not suit Numerical Value or Data Interpretation, so replace those 3 questions with additional Single Correct MCQs -> Single Correct 15, Statement 5, A-R 3, Matching 3, MultiCorrect 3, FillBlank 1. Difficulty distribution for 'foundation': Easy 40%, Medium 40%, Hard 15%, Very Hard 5%. Intersperse types randomly; never more than 3-4 consecutive questions of the same type.
Calibrate every question to 10+2 level. For Section A, do NOT produce comprehension passages, cloze passages, para jumbles or narration items — they are not in the Constable syllabus.

Ensure all questions follow the exact JSON schema from Section 5 of the steering prompt. Every explanation must state why the correct option is right AND give a specific reason each of the other three options is wrong (min ~180 characters).
Balance the answer key across the four option positions (each position used, spread within 3 of each other).
Save the generated JSON to mock-tests/tests/1_test_A_articles.json.
Run: python3 mock-tests/_validate.py mock-tests/tests/1_test_A_articles.json and fix any reported failure.
Run: python3 mock-tests/_record_test.py 1 from the repo root to update history, config, manifest, and STUDY_PLAN.md.

reference_count_tables.note: Counts per total-questions N, from Section 1 of the steering prompt. Order: SingleCorrect, Statement, AssertionReason, Matching, MultipleCorrect, FillBlank, NumericalValue, DataInterpretation.

reference_full_test_ratio.note: Section-wise question counts for a mixed/full test (A:B:C:D:E = 25:25:10:25:15).

acceptance_criteria: File mock-tests/tests/1_test_A_articles.json exists with valid JSON containing exactly 30 questions
All question types match the 30Q count table distribution (with the documented Section-A substitution)
Every question's subject field is a valid section letter A-E
No question stem duplicates or near-duplicates any entry in history/A.json
findings: Fill in after generation: actual type counts, answer-position balance (e.g. A=7, B=8, C=8, D=7), duplicate check result, and the config next_test value.
